current_evidence: Swindon publishes its validation requirements only as seven web checklist pages under 'Checklists for planning applications', with no local list PDF. The index page and a web search found no newer list, consultation or validation guidance document. The pages show no adoption or update date in their text (only 2015 metadata and a reference to applications from 6 Dec 2023).

issues.detail: Grokbot captured none of the supporting-document requirements on the Non-householder checklist, and marks Full planning, Outline and Reserved matters '(none)'. The source lists, by trigger: Archaeological Assessment (if archaeology affected). Ecological Impact Assessment plus Defra Biodiversity Metric (if wildlife or biodiversity affected). CIL Additional Information form (any floorspace creation, including residential extensions, new dwellings of any size, and conversions of disused buildings). Community Involvement Statement (all major). Design and Access Statement (all major, and in a conservation area 1+ dwellings or 100 sqm+). Environmental Statement (under EIA Regs). Flood Risk Assessment (all development in Flood Zones 2/3, or 1 ha+). Heritage Statement (heritage assets affected). Habitats Regulation Assessment (per council guidance). Land Contamination Assessment (known or suspected contamination). Noise Impact Assessment (affects noise-sensitive properties or significant noise generation). Infrastructure Requirements Statement (all major; residential 11-14 units on sites over 0.5 ha; 6-10 units in the AONB on sites over 0.5 ha). Retail Impact Assessment (all major retail). Structural Survey (substantial demolition or excavation). Town Centre Uses Impact Assessment (town centre uses). Transport Assessment (significant transport implications). Tree Survey/Arboricultural Statement (trees on or adjacent to the site affected). The same list applies to the planning permission + LBC, outline and reserved matters checklists.
issues.evidence: Non-householder checklist page, 'Supporting documents (where applicable)' section

issues.detail: Householder is marked '(none)', but the householder checklist requires the CIL Additional Information form for floorspace creation including residential extensions. Where the dwelling is listed, it also requires floor plans showing historic features, elevations with materials and finishes, detailed drawings of affected features at 1:20 or 1:50, a Heritage Impact Assessment, and a structural survey where relevant.
issues.evidence: Householder consent checklist: 'Community Infrastructure Levy (CIL) Additional Information form'; listed-dwelling additional requirements

issues.detail: Other application types marked '(none)' do have local requirements on the Non-householder page. Removal or variation of conditions (S73) needs a statement of reasons and a Deed of Variation where the original permission had S106 obligations. Works to trees (TPO) needs a specification of works, statement of reasons, an arboriculturist's report for health or safety reasons, and a structural engineer's plus arboriculturist's report for alleged subsidence. Non-material amendment needs a site location plan, block plan, and proposed plans or elevations identifying the amendment. Extension of time and Hedgerow removal checklists (ecological assessment, woody-species tree survey, landscape and heritage assessment) are also not captured.

'Archaeological Assessment' and 'Environmental Statement (EIA)' are placed under Listed building consent based on general explanatory text on the Heritage statements guidance page. That text only says heritage statements may relate to such documents; it does not make archaeology or EIA an LBC requirement. On the checklists, both are supporting documents for planning applications, triggered by archaeology being affected or by the EIA Regulations.
issues.evidence: 'They may also include or be related to documents such as Archaeological Assessments ... or may form part of any necessary Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA)'

issues.detail: Most of Grokbot's 17 tab items are not requirements. Six 'Local forms / checklists' items are just checklist page titles and scope blurbs (adverts, LDC, householder, listed buildings, non-householder, prior notifications, heritage statements). Three items are Validation Team contact text, with phone or email. One item is a list of external website links (CIfA, Building Conservation Directory, IHBC). The paper-copies item is process text run together with other checklist fragments.
issues.evidence: 'If you have any queries regarding the above requirements, you can contact the Validation Team by email at validation@swindon.gov.uk'

issues.detail: The drawing-standard sentence (north point, paper size, scale bar of at least 0-10 m) is captured five times, each with different trailing fragments ('the correct fee', 'a completed application form', 'a Site Location Plan...'). The major-application CD requirement is captured twice.
issues.evidence: 'You should include: plans and drawings which must show a North point, give a paper size ... minimum of 0-10 metres.' (x5)

issues.detail: Several items are scraped run-ons that splice unrelated checklist lines together. For example, the drawing standard runs into 'the correct fee a Site Location Plan', and the paper-copies item runs into 'drawings and details by identified conditions ... Removal or variation of conditions Use this checklist...'. They are not usable requirement statements.
issues.evidence: Grokbot tab_items 'Drawing / document standards' and 'Submission rules'

issues.detail: The workbook link points only to the Non-householder sub-page (/5). The householder, listed building, advertisement, lawful development certificate and prior notification requirements are on sibling pages /1 to /7 under 'Checklists for planning applications'. The list carries no visible adoption or review date, so 'Undated' is correct, but there is no evidence of a review within the last 2 years.
issues.evidence: Checklist index page lists 7 checklist pages; only 2015 metadata dates

summary: Grokbot's link works and appears to be Swindon's current (undated) web-based validation checklist; no newer list exists. Grokbot captured almost nothing of substance: 17 supporting-document requirements (FRA, DAS, ecology/biodiversity metric, CIL form, Infrastructure Requirements Statement, Transport, Trees etc.) and the householder/S73/tree-works requirements are missing. Most captured items are page titles, contact details or duplicates.
